historia: Fine-origin Latin American chocolate, a cacao museum and an artisan boutique in the heart of Centro Histórico.
descripcion: We make the most authentic Latin American chocolate, hand in hand with local communities, developing sustainable production of fine cacao at its origin. Here you will find our Cacao Museum, where you can learn how chocolate is made, our Chocolate Laboratory, where all our desserts and bonbons are made, and our Chocolate Boutique, which offers cold and hot drinks, high-quality baked goods, our famous chocolate bars and other souvenirs.

historia: Coffee Factory was founded in 2019 in Quito. Its coffee is grown at Finca Vista Hermosa in Nanegalito, Pichincha, at 1,850 meters above sea level. They also offer unique handmade sweet and savory products.
descripcion: A small, cozy spot where Ecuadorian single-origin coffee is the star. Sebastián welcomes you with sparkling water and guides you through a sensory experience: he explains the food pairings, the notes of each variety and where each bean comes from before preparing it. The menu has affogatos, golden coffee, matcha latte and artisan desserts such as coffee cheesecake and corn cake. It has its own parking.

especialidad: Croissants and fresh bread, European style
historia: With more than 30 years of experience, Quito Deli keeps the traditional European style of baking and pastry in the city. The smell of freshly baked bread is its signature touch, and it creates a unique atmosphere for mornings or afternoons with a good coffee and its companions.
descripcion: At Quito Deli you will find a wide selection of cakes, desserts and freshly baked bread, plus sandwiches, fresh juices, cookies, coffee and a healthy corner. Quito Deli also serves light lunches and elaborate dinners to enjoy with family and friends.
